content:
Hours before Apple's official unveiling of its first foldable iPhone, Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman revealed some final-stage details, including the official name of the foldable iPhone: iPhone Duo.

iPhone Ultra is actually iPhone Duo

Apple's first foldable iPhone is also the company's first phone to feature both inner and outer displays. Two screens in one device, named iPhone Duo.

Gurman also reported that the device will be priced as much as two iPhones, reaching US$1,999. However, this pricing is still lower than some analysts' earlier predictions.

He pointed out that, to keep the iPhone Duo competitive, Apple is absorbing part of the recent rise in memory component costs itself.

Another iPhone Duo? This time about colour options: the Duo will be available in white and dark blue.

Gurman also revealed that the foldable iPhone Duo will 'go on sale as early as October', but did not mention a specific release date. This may ship a few weeks later than the iPhone 18 Pro, which is still expected to launch this month.

The iPhone Duo is also expected to support the Apple Pencil. There had been related discussions previously, but support was not widely expected to materialise.

In any case, the launch event will begin at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time, roughly 12 hours from now. More updates will follow later.

The full report is available on Bloomberg.
